name: Todoist
description: Todoist in the bar: the mark with an optional task count, and a panel with Today, Inbox and All, overdue first, to complete, edit, delete and quick-add tasks (Todoist's own parser: p1, #Project, dates). Off by default. The API token is kept in a private state file, never in shell.json, and only ever sent to api.todoist.com

debugIpc.description: Test hook: answer state() on IPC target haseen.todoist (refresh, tasks and complete always answer)
